notes.title: New original tracks added to A Summer with the Shiba Inu! (Free update)
notes.content:
Hello all,

I'm very happy to announce that brand new soundtracks have been pushed to the game - free for owners!

Feel free to listen to some of the full tracks on SoundCloud as well - https://soundcloud.com/effreylementsomposer/sets/summer-with-the-shiba-inu-part-2

In addition, the soundtrack files (.wav) will be available as a DLC download, with  40% off discount for a limited period of time! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1181250/A_Summer_with_the_Shiba_Inu__Original_Soundtrack/

Please note that the DLC does not add any new tracks or functionality for the game - as all the tracks appear within the base game - all proceeds go towards supporting the composer.
